sourceReadings.label: Tislelizumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: TEVIMBRA is a programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1)-blocking antibody indicated for: Esophageal Cancer in combination with platinum-containing chemotherapy for the first-line treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) whose tumors express PD-L1 (≥1).

sourceReadings.label: Tislelizumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The safety and effectiveness of TEVIMBRA have not been established in pediatric patients.

sourceReadings.label: Tislelizumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Tislelizumab-jsgr binds to PD-1 and blocks its interaction with PD-L1 and PD-L2, releasing PD-1 pathway-mediated inhibition of the immune response, including the anti-tumor immune response.

sourceReadings.label: Tislelizumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Tislelizumab-jsgr decreased tumor growth in xenograft models and a human PD-1 transgenic mouse model.

sourceReadings.label: Tislelizumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Tislelizumab-jsgr is an Fc-engineered humanized monoclonal IgG4 kappa antibody with an approximate molecular weight of 147 kDa.

sourceReadings.label: Tislelizumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Upregulation of PD-1 ligands occurs in some tumors and signaling through this pathway can contribute to inhibition of active T-cell immune surveillance of tumors.

sourceReadings.label: Tislelizumab label

Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Binding of the PD-1 ligands, PD-L1 and PD-L2, to the PD-1 receptor found on T cells, inhibits T cell proliferation and cytokine production.

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Clinical studies of LOQTORZI did not include sufficient numbers of patients aged 65 years and over with NPC to determine whether they respond differently from younger patients.

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Distribution The mean volume of distribution at steady state (V ss ) of toripalimab-tpzi was 3.7 L (27%).

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In syngeneic mouse tumor models, blocking PD-1 activity resulted in decreased tumor growth.

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: LOQTORZI is a programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1)- blocking antibody indicated: in combination with cisplatin and gemcitabine, for first-line treatment of adults with metastatic or with recurrent locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) ( 1.1 )

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary Based on its mechanism of action, LOQTORZI can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman [ see Clinical Pharmacology (12.1) ] .

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary There are no data on the presence of toripalimab-tpzi in human milk or its effects on the breastfed child or on milk production.

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The mean terminal half-life (t 1/2 ) (± standard deviation) was 10 ± 1.5 days after the first dose and 18 ± 9.4 days at steady state.

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The safety and effectiveness of LOQTORZI have not been established in pediatric patients [see Indications and Usage (1) ].

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Toripalimab-tpzi is a humanized IgG4 monoclonal antibody that binds to the PD-1 receptor and blocks its interaction with PD-L1 and PD-L2, releasing PD-1 pathway-mediated inhibition of the immune response, including the anti-tumor immune response.

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Toripalimab-tpzi is a humanized immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) kappa immunoglobulin that has a predicted molecular weight of approximately 150 kDa.

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Upregulation of PD-1 ligands occurs in some tumors and signaling through this pathway can contribute to inhibition of active T-cell immune surveillance of tumors.

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: as a single agent for the treatment of adults with recurrent unresectable or metastatic NPC with disease progression on or after a platinum-containing chemotherapy ( 1.2 )

sourceReadings.label: Toripalimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: cautions (5.3) ] LOQTORZI in Combination with Cisplatin and Gemcitabine The most common adverse reactions (≥ 20%) are nausea, vomiting, decreased appetite, constipation, hypothyroidism, rash, pyrexia, diarrhea, peripheral neuropathy, cough, musculoskeletal pain, upper respiratory infection, insomnia, dizziness, and malaise.

queue.question: Does this record name the same registered substance as Valproate? Both records carry UNII 614OI1Z5WI. Someone needs to decide whether these records should be merged, cross-linked as alternative names for one substance, or left separate. Nothing here decides that, and no record has been changed.
queue.basis: Grouped on a shared substance identifier. 1 recorded fields match, 3 do not match, and 0 cannot be placed on one scale. Matching fields are not proof of one substance, and fields that do not match are not proof of two. Priority ranks the shared identifier signal above the shared document signal, then by how many recorded fields both records hold.

sourceReadings.excerpt: Abacavir is an antiretroviral agent [see Microbiology (12.4) ].

sourceReadings.label: ABACAVIR SULFATE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Abacavir tablets, a nucleoside analogue human immunodeficiency virus (HIV-1) reverse transcriptase inhibitor, are indicated in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV-1 infection.

sourceReadings.label: ABACAVIR SULFATE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Abacavir tablets, in combination with other antiretroviral agents, are indicated for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV-1) infection.

sourceReadings.label: ABACAVIR SULFATE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Based on in vitro study results, abacavir at therapeutic drug exposures is not expected to affect the pharmacokinetics of drugs that are substrates of the following transporters: organic anion transporter polypeptide (OATP)1B1/3, breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) or P-glycoprotein (P-gp), organic cation transporter (OCT)1, OCT2, or multidrug and toxic extrusion protein (MATE)1 and MATE2-K.

sourceReadings.label: ABACAVIR SULFATE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Abacavir on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Agents In vitro studies have shown that abacavir has potential to inhibit CYP1A1 and limited potential to inhibit metabolism mediated by CYP3A4.

sourceReadings.label: ABACAVIR SULFATE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Effect of Other Agents on the Pharmacokinetics of Abacavir In vitro , abacavir is not a substrate of OATP1B1, OAP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, MATE1, MATE2-K, multidrug resistance-associated protein (MRP)2 or MRP4; therefore, drugs that modulate these transporters are not expected to affect abacavir plasma concentrations.

sourceReadings.label: ABACAVIR SULFATE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In vitro experiments reveal that abacavir does not inhibit human CYP3A4, CYP2D6, or CYP2C9 activity at clinically relevant concentrations.

sourceReadings.label: ABACAVIR SULFATE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: It has a molecular formula of (C 14 H 18 N 6 O) 2 •H 2 SO 4 and a molecular weight of 670.76 g per mol.

sourceReadings.label: ABACAVIR SULFATE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The geometric mean absolute bioavailability of the tablet was 83%.

sourceReadings.label: DOLUTEGRAVIR SODIUM label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Dolutegravir is an HIV-1 antiretroviral agent [see Microbiology ( 12.4 )].

sourceReadings.label: DOLUTEGRAVIR SODIUM label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Elimination Dolutegravir has a terminal half-life of approximately 14 hours and an apparent clearance (CL/F) of 1.0 L/h based on population pharmacokinetic analyses.

sourceReadings.label: DOLUTEGRAVIR SODIUM label
sourceReadings.excerpt: TIVICAY and TIVICAY PD are an HIV-1 integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI) indicated in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in adults (treatment-naïve or -experienced) and in pediatric patients (treatment-naïve or -experienced but INSTI- naïve) aged at least 4 weeks and weighing at least 3 kg.

sourceReadings.label: DOLUTEGRAVIR SODIUM label
sourceReadings.excerpt: TIVICAY and TIVICAY PD are indicated in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV‑1 infection in adults (treatment-naïve or -experienced) and in pediatric patients (treatment-naïve or -experienced but integrase strand transfer inhibitor [INSTI]-naïve) aged at least 4 weeks and weighing at least 3 kg [see Microbiology ( 12.4 )].

sourceReadings.label: DOLUTEGRAVIR SODIUM label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The empirical formula is C 20 H 18 F 2 N 3 NaO 5, and the molecular weight is 441.36 g/mol.

sourceReadings.label: LAMIVUDINE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Absorption and Bioavailability Absolute bioavailability in 12 adult subjects was 86% ± 16% (mean ± SD) for the 150-mg tablet and 87% ± 13% for the oral solution.

sourceReadings.label: LAMIVUDINE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Effect of Other Agents on the Pharmacokinetics of Lamivudine Lamivudine is a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, and OCT2 in vitro.

sourceReadings.label: LAMIVUDINE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In most single-dose trials in HIV-1-infected subjects, HBV-infected subjects, or healthy subjects with serum sampling for 24 hours after dosing, the observed mean elimination half-life (t½) ranged from 5 to 7 hours.

sourceReadings.label: LAMIVUDINE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: It has a molecular formula of C 8 H 11 N 3 O 3 S·0.2CH 4 O and a molecular weight of 235.66 g/mol.

sourceReadings.label: LAMIVUDINE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Lamivudine is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP; however, considering its absolute bioavailability (87%), it is unlikely that these transporters play a significant role in the absorption of lamivudine.

sourceReadings.label: LAMIVUDINE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Lamivudine is an antiretroviral agent [see Microbiology ( 12.4 )].

sourceReadings.label: LAMIVUDINE label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Lamivudine tablets are a nucleoside analogue indicated in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) infection.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In vitro and in vivo data indicate that ivacaftor is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: SYMDEKO is a combination of tezacaftor and ivacaftor, indicated for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients aged 6 years and older who are homozygous for the F508del mutation or who have at least one mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator ( CFTR ) gene that is responsive to tezacaftor/ivacaftor based on in vitro data and/or clinical evidence.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Tezacaftor facilitates the cellular processing and trafficking of select mutant forms of CFTR (including F508del-CFTR) to increase the amount of mature CFTR protein delivered to the cell surface.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: , Including Suicidal Thoughts and Behaviors [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4) ] Cataracts [see Warnings and Precautions (5.6) ] The most common adverse drug reactions to SYMDEKO (occurring in ≥3% of patients) were headache, nausea, sinus congestion, and dizziness.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Based on in vitro results, ivacaftor has the potential to inhibit CYP3A and P-gp, and may also inhibit CYP2C9.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Based on in vitro results, tezacaftor has a low potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Clinical trials of SYMDEKO did not include sufficient numbers of patients 65 years of age and over to determine whether they respond differently from younger patients.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Co-administration of SYMDEKO with digoxin, a sensitive P-gp substrate, increased digoxin exposure by 1.3-fold.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Co-administration of SYMDEKO with pitavastatin, an OATP1B1 substrate, had no clinically relevant effect on the exposure of pitavastatin.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: For ivacaftor to function CFTR protein must be present at the cell surface.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: If the patient's genotype is unknown, an FDA-cleared CF mutation test should be used to detect the presence of a CFTR mutation followed by verification with bi-directional sequencing when recommended by the mutation test instructions for use.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In vitro and in vivo data indicate that ivacaftor is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In vitro data suggested that tezacaftor is metabolized mainly by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In vitro studies showed that ivacaftor is not a substrate for OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or P-gp.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In vitro studies showed that tezacaftor is a substrate for the uptake transporter OATP1B1, and efflux transporters P-gp and BCRP.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Its molecular formula is C 26 H 27 N 2 F 3 O 6 and its molecular weight is 520.50.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Ivacaftor can potentiate the CFTR protein delivered to the cell surface by tezacaftor, leading to a further enhancement of chloride transport than either agent alone.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Ivacaftor is a CFTR potentiator that facilitates increased chloride transport by potentiating the channel-open probability (or gating) of the CFTR protein at the cell surface.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Ivacaftor is not an inhibitor of transporters OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: No dosage adjustment is necessary for patients with mild hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class A).

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Potential for Other Drugs to Affect Tezacaftor/Ivacaftor In vitro studies showed that ivacaftor and tezacaftor were substrates of CYP3A enzymes ( i.e. , CYP3A4 and CYP3A5).

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Potential for Tezacaftor/Ivacaftor to Affect Other Drugs Clinical studies (with rosiglitazone and desipramine – see Table 9 ) showed that ivacaftor is not an inhibitor of CYP2C8 or CYP2D6.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary There are limited and incomplete human data from clinical trials and postmarketing reports on the use of SYMDEKO or its individual components, tezacaftor and ivacaftor, in pregnant women to inform a drug-associated risk.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary There is no information regarding the presence of tezacaftor or ivacaftor in human milk, the effects on the breastfed infant, or the effects on milk production.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: SYMDEKO has not been studied in patients with moderate or severe renal impairment or in patients with end-stage renal disease.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: SYMDEKO is a combination of tezacaftor and ivacaftor, indicated for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients aged 6 years and older who are homozygous for the F508del mutation or who have at least one mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator ( CFTR ) gene that is responsive to tezacaftor/ivacaftor based on in vitro data and/or clinical evidence.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Tezacaftor facilitates the cellular processing and trafficking of select mutant forms of CFTR (including F508del-CFTR) to increase the amount of mature CFTR protein delivered to the cell surface.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Tezacaftor has a low potential to induce CYP3A, but it is not an inducer of CYP1A2 and CYP2B6.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Tezacaftor has a low potential to inhibit transporters P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3.

sourceReadings.label: Ivacaftor, Tezacaftor label

sourceReadings.label: Lanadelumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: An additional 13 pediatric patients aged 12 to <18 years were enrolled in the open-label extension study [see Adverse Reactions (6.1) , Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) and Clinical Studies (14) ].

sourceReadings.label: Lanadelumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In patients with HAE due to C1-inhibitor (C1-INH) deficiency or dysfunction, normal regulation of plasma kallikrein activity is not present, which leads to uncontrolled increases in plasma kallikrein activity and results in angioedema attacks.

sourceReadings.label: Lanadelumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Lanadelumab-flyo decreases plasma kallikrein activity to control excess bradykinin generation in patients with HAE.

sourceReadings.label: Lanadelumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Lanadelumab-flyo is a fully human monoclonal antibody (IgG1/κ-light chain) that binds plasma kallikrein and inhibits its proteolytic activity.

sourceReadings.label: Lanadelumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Plasma kallikrein is a protease that cleaves high-molecular-weight-kininogen (HMWK) to generate cleaved HMWK (cHMWK) and bradykinin, a potent vasodilator that increases vascular permeability resulting in swelling and pain associated with HAE.

sourceReadings.label: Lanadelumab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary There are no available data on TAKHZYRO use in pregnant women to inform any drug associated risks.

sourceReadings.label: Lanadelumab label

sourceReadings.label: Published labels naming Tividenofusp alfa as an active ingredient
Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: AVLAYAH is indicated for the treatment of neurologic manifestations of Hunter syndrome (Mucopolysaccharidosis type II, MPS II) when initiated in presymptomatic or symptomatic pediatric patients weighing at least 5 kg prior to advanced neurologic impairment.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Clinical trials of AVLAYAH in patients with Hunter syndrome did not include patients 65 years of age or older.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s).

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Hunter syndrome is an inherited X-linked recessive lysosomal storage disease caused by a deficiency of iduronate-2-sulfatase (IDS), a lysosomal enzyme, that degrades heparan sulfate (HS) and dermatan sulfate (DS), the two primary glycosominoglycans (GAGs) in the lysosome.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Insufficiency or absence of IDS leads to accumulation of GAGs, including HS and DS, and subsequent lysosome dysfunction in multiple organs and tissues, including the central nervous system (CNS).

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary There are no available data on the use of AVLAYAH during pregnancy to evaluate for a drug-associated risk of major birth defects, miscarriage, or other adverse maternal or fetal outcomes.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary There are no data on the presence of tividenofusp alfa-eknm in either human or animal milk, the effects on the breastfed infant, or the effects on milk production.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The approximate molecular weight of tividenofusp alfa-eknm is 110 kDa.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The fragment, crystallizable (Fc) component of tividenofusp alfa-eknm binds to the apical domain of the transferrin receptor (TfR) and delivers IDS to peripheral tissues and to the CNS through receptor-mediated transcytosis across the blood-brain barrier.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The safety and effectiveness of AVLAYAH have not been established in pediatric patients weighing less than 5 kg.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on the reduction of cerebrospinal fluid heparan sulfate [see Clinical Studies (14) ] .

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Tividenofusp alfa-eknm provides an exogenous source of IDS.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label
sourceReadings.excerpt: WARNING: HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS INCLUDING ANAPHYLAXIS Patients treated with enzyme replacement therapies, including AVLAYAH, have experienced life-threatening hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp alfa label

sourceReadings.excerpt: AVLAYAH is indicated for the treatment of neurologic manifestations of Hunter syndrome (Mucopolysaccharidosis type II, MPS II) when initiated in presymptomatic or symptomatic pediatric patients weighing at least 5 kg prior to advanced neurologic impairment.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp Alfa-Eknm label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Hunter syndrome is an inherited X-linked recessive lysosomal storage disease caused by a deficiency of iduronate-2-sulfatase (IDS), a lysosomal enzyme, that degrades heparan sulfate (HS) and dermatan sulfate (DS), the two primary glycosominoglycans (GAGs) in the lysosome.

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp Alfa-Eknm label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Insufficiency or absence of IDS leads to accumulation of GAGs, including HS and DS, and subsequent lysosome dysfunction in multiple organs and tissues, including the central nervous system (CNS).

sourceReadings.label: Tividenofusp Alfa-Eknm label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary There are no available data on the use of AVLAYAH during pregnancy to evaluate for a drug-associated risk of major birth defects, miscarriage, or other adverse maternal or fetal outcomes.

queue.question: Does this record name the same registered substance as Crovalimab? Both records were structured from the same FDA label document 2597efc2-a97b-487c-b500-a67fd282a73b, which is weaker evidence of identity than a shared substance identifier. Someone needs to decide whether these records should be merged, cross-linked as alternative names for one substance, or left separate. Nothing here decides that, and no record has been changed.
queue.basis: Grouped on a shared source document and a recorded name wholly contained in the other. 5 recorded fields match, 0 do not match, and 0 cannot be placed on one scale. Matching fields are not proof of one substance, and fields that do not match are not proof of two. Priority ranks the shared identifier signal above the shared document signal, then by how many recorded fields both records hold.

queue.basis: Grouped on a shared source document and a recorded name wholly contained in the other. 4 recorded fields match, 0 do not match, and 0 cannot be placed on one scale. Matching fields are not proof of one substance, and fields that do not match are not proof of two. Priority ranks the shared identifier signal above the shared document signal, then by how many recorded fields both records hold.

sourceReadings.excerpt: Clinical studies of TRUTAKNA did not include sufficient numbers of patients aged 65 and over to determine whether they respond differently from younger adult patients.

sourceReadings.label: Atacicept label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Reduction in BAFF- and APRIL-mediated signaling decreases production of serum galactose deficient IgA1 (Gd-IgA1), which is implicated in the pathophysiology of IgAN.

sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary Available data on TRUTAKNA use in pregnant women exposed during clinical trials are insufficient to evaluate for a drug-associated risk of major birth defects, miscarriage, or other adverse maternal or fetal outcomes.

Both records were structured from the same FDA label document 3516e753-f064-4d30-9bd5-e3f2e143f75d, which is weaker evidence of identity than a shared substance identifier. Someone needs to decide whether these records should be merged, cross-linked as alternative names for one substance, or left separate. Nothing here decides that, and no record has been changed.
queue.basis: Grouped on a shared source document and a recorded name wholly contained in the other. 4 recorded fields match, 0 do not match, and 0 cannot be placed on one scale. Matching fields are not proof of one substance, and fields that do not match are not proof of two. Priority ranks the shared identifier signal above the shared document signal, then by how many recorded fields both records hold.

queue.question: Does this record name the same registered substance as Sacituzumab Govitecan-Hziy? Both records were structured from the same FDA label document 57a597d2-03f0-472e-b148-016d7169169d, which is weaker evidence of identity than a shared substance identifier. Someone needs to decide whether these records should be merged, cross-linked as alternative names for one substance, or left separate. Nothing here decides that, and no record has been changed.
queue.basis: Grouped on a shared source document and a recorded name wholly contained in the other. 4 recorded fields match, 0 do not match, and 0 cannot be placed on one scale. Matching fields are not proof of one substance, and fields that do not match are not proof of two. Priority ranks the shared identifier signal above the shared document signal, then by how many recorded fields both records hold.

sourceReadings.label: Sacituzumab Govitecan label
sourceReadings.excerpt: TRODELVY is contraindicated in patients who have experienced a severe hypersensitivity reaction to TRODELVY [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3) ] .

sourceReadings.label: Published labels naming Bulevirtide as an active ingredient
Bulevirtide label naming this substance alone
Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: An improvement in disease-related clinical outcomes has not been established.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Bulevirtide acetate has a molecular formula of C 248 H 355 N 65 O 72 (net) and a molecular weight of 5398.9 Da (average mass, net), and has the following structural formula: HEPCLUDEX (bulevirtide-gmod) for injection is a sterile, preservative-free, white to off-white lyophilized powder or cake for subcutaneous injection after reconstitution.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Bulevirtide inhibits HDV infection by binding to the HDV receptor NTCP on the plasma membrane of hepatocytes, blocking HDV attachment to NTCP.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Bulevirtide is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Clinical trials of HEPCLUDEX did not include participants aged 65 and over to determine whether they respond differently from younger participants [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ].

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Consistent with in vitro results, bulevirtide at steady state did not impact the pharmacokinetics of the CYP3A4 probe substrate midazolam, administered as an oral 30 μg microdose, in clinical drug-interaction studies.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: HEPCLUDEX is an antiviral drug [see Microbiology (12.4) ].

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: HEPCLUDEX is indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV) infection in adults without cirrhosis or with compensated cirrhosis.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that bulevirtide inhibits the organic anion transporting polypeptides, OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, with IC 50 values of 0.5 and 8.7 μM, respectively, and taurocholate uptake via NTCP receptors with an IC 50 value of 0.320 μM; however, no clinical drug interaction is expected for OATP1B or NTCP substrates at clinically relevant concentrations of bulevirtide.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Mechanism of Action Bulevirtide is a synthetic 47-amino acid lipopeptide with a myristoylated N-terminus and an amidated C-terminus derived from amino acids 13-59 of the L-HBsAg preS1 domain from an HBV genotype (GT)-C consensus sequence (corresponding to GT-D preS1 amino acids 2-48).

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: No dosage adjustment of HEPCLUDEX is recommended in patients with mild hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class A) [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ].

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: No dosage adjustment of HEPCLUDEX is recommended in patients with mild, moderate, or severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance [CrCl] greater than or equal to 15 mL per minute) [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ].

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary It is not known whether bulevirtide is present in human breast milk, affects human milk production, or has effects on the breastfed infant.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary There are insufficient human data on the use of HEPCLUDEX during pregnancy to inform a drug-associated risk of birth defects and miscarriage.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The most common adverse reactions (incidence greater than or equal to 10%, all grades) observed with treatment with HEPCLUDEX are injection site reactions, headache, abdominal pain, fatigue, and pruritus .

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The safety and effectiveness of HEPCLUDEX in pediatric patients less than 18 years of age have not been established.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on a decrease in HDV RNA and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization [see Clinical Studies (14) ] .

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Transporter Systems: In vitro studies have shown that no clinically relevant interactions are expected for efflux transporters including MDR1, BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, and MATE2K and uptake transporters including OATP2B1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, and OCT2.

sourceReadings.label: Bulevirtide label
sourceReadings.excerpt: WARNING: POSTTREATMENT SEVERE ACUTE EXACERBATION OF HEPATITIS D and B Severe acute exacerbations of hepatitis D and hepatitis B may occur after HEPCLUDEX is discontinued, especially in patients with cirrhosis, who may be at increased risk of more severe flares or progression to hepatic decompensation.

sourceReadings.label: Ansuvimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Ansuvimab-zykl is a recombinant human monoclonal antibody with antiviral activity against Orthoebolavirus zairense [see Microbiology (12.4) ] .

sourceReadings.label: Ansuvimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Ansuvimab-zykl is produced in Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells by recombinant DNA technology and has an approximate molecular weight of 147 kDa.

sourceReadings.label: Ansuvimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Clinical trials of EBANGA did not include sufficient numbers of participants aged 65 and over to determine whether the safety profile of EBANGA is different in this population compared to younger participants.

sourceReadings.label: Ansuvimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: EBANGA (ansuvimab-zykl) is an Orthoebolavirus zairense glycoprotein (EBOV GP)-directed human monoclonal antibody indicated for the treatment of infection caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense in adult and pediatric patients, including neonates born to a mother who is RT-PCR positive for Orthoebolavirus zairense infection.

sourceReadings.label: Ansuvimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: EBANGA is indicated for the treatment of infection caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense (formerly Zaire ebolavirus) in adult and pediatric patients, including neonates born to a mother who is RT-PCR positive for Orthoebolavirus zairense infection [see Dosage and Administration (2.2) and Clinical Studies (14) ].

sourceReadings.label: Ansuvimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary Orthoebolavirus zairense infection is life-threatening for both the mother and fetus and treatment should not be withheld due to pregnancy (see Clinical Considerations ) .

sourceReadings.label: Ansuvimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: Risk Summary The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention recommend that mothers with confirmed Orthoebolavirus zairense not breastfeed their infants to reduce the risk of postnatal transmission of Orthoebolavirus zairense infection.

sourceReadings.label: Ansuvimab label
sourceReadings.excerpt: The safety and effectiveness of EBANGA for the treatment of infection caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense have been established in pediatric patients from birth to less than 18 years of age.

Matching fields are not proof of one substance, and fields that do not match are not proof of two. Priority ranks the shared identifier signal above the shared document signal, then by how many recorded fields both records hold.

caveats: A group is a question, not a conclusion. Nothing here has been merged, cross-linked or changed, and no group states that two names are one substance.

The UNII on a record was read from a source at authoring time. This agent did not resolve it against the substance registry, so a wrongly recorded identifier produces a wrong group and a missing one hides a real pair.

Names separated by a salt, ester, hydrate or counterion word are excluded and counted. The word list is fixed, so a salt form named by a word outside it would not be detected, and a reviewer should read the names as well as the counts.

Sharing a source document is weak evidence. It is reported only for records whose source declared a single active substance and whose recorded names contain one another, and even then it catches originator and biosimilar naming as readily as it catches a true duplicate.
Both filters on the document signal are lexical, so two genuine synonyms recorded under unrelated names are not found by it at all.

The document signal reports pairs and never chains them. Two records that share no document are never placed in one group by way of a third record, so a record can appear in more than one pair and each pair stands or falls on its own.
Field comparison reports whether recorded readings match. It never selects a reading, and a field that does not match is not a finding that either record is wrong.
Readings in different units are marked as not comparable and are left in their recorded units. Nothing here converts between them.
Records that agree on every compared field are not thereby one substance, and records that differ are not thereby two.
